Dice, decoded.

A small guide to choosing with confidence.

Explore the beginner’s guide +

01 / THE SHORTHAND

A letter. A number. A little less mystery.

D stands for die, and the number tells you its sides. For example, 2D6 means roll two six-sided dice and add their results.

2D6

how many · die · sides

02 / MEET THE PARTY

The seven-piece set, decoded.

Each set in our collection includes one of each below. Check your game’s requirements with your group; some games call for extra dice.

  • 4

    D4

    Four sides.

  • 6

    D6

    Six sides. The familiar cube.

  • 8

    D8

    Eight sides.

  • 10

    D10

    Ten sides. The ones die in a percentile pair.

  • %

    D%

    A ten-sided die marked in tens, from 00 to 90.

  • 12

    D12

    Twelve sides.

  • 20

    D20

    Twenty sides.

What about D100? For a D&D percentile roll, pair D% with D10: 70 and 1 make 71; 00 and 0 make 100.

Browse buttons reset your search and filters to show your choice.

03 / PICK YOUR FEEL

Same adventure. A different material.

Here’s how the materials appear in our collection. Check each product’s size, price, and included dice before choosing.

01

Resin

Colorful singles and seven-piece sets, from terracotta Ember to dusky-blue Starlight.

02

Acrylic

Our Ivory D6 and Tide D20: two individual dice with classic ivory and ocean-teal colors.

03

Metal

Forged D20 and Copperbound Set are described with a weighty feel. A dice tray helps protect the table.

Material doesn’t change the number of sides or pieces included. Single dice and seven-piece sets are labeled separately.

Dice notation reference: D&D Basic Rules: game dice. Your game’s rules determine which dice you need.
